scenario: Floa Reader PDF selection/highlight restore, PDF search/switch, EPUB render/search/bookmark

reference.source: Glaso public guided animation, Reader lesson
observedUserActions: Select a passage and save it as a highlight
Return to the document and see the highlight again
reference.fidelity: Behavioral comparison only; no Glaso code, binaries, or assets used.

application.name: Floa Reader renderer
application.runtime: Chrome headless with the extracted macOS arm64 app.asar served over loopback HTTP
application.bridge: readerApp IPC surface stubbed in page initialization; renderer code and PDF.js were not stubbed

packagedArtifact.codeSigning: Skipped because the installed Developer ID identity is not trusted.

fixtures.content: only alpha phrase appears on page one
only bravo phrase appears on page one

observations.step: Open the most recent Alpha document
observations.evidence: Reader displayed Document Alpha.pdf and rendered its first PDF canvas; metadata reported PDF · 240 pages.

observations.step: Select text in the PDF and save a highlight
observations.evidence: PDF.js TextLayer spans were selectable; the renderer enabled Highlight, sent the selected phrase and page number to the persistence bridge, and displayed a correctly aligned yellow overlay. Screenshot: floa-reader-pdf-highlight-headless-2026-11-26.png.

observations.step: Open another document and return to the highlighted PDF
observations.evidence: The saved text highlight was rendered again after the PDF was reopened.

observations.step: Remove the saved highlight while its PDF is open
observations.evidence: The packaged renderer removed the corresponding PDF overlay immediately after the mocked persistence bridge accepted removal, without reopening the document.

observations.step: Open EPUB, search within its spine sections, and bookmark a result location
observations.evidence: The packaged reader rendered the EPUB content, showed a search result, and sent an EPUB CFI to the mocked bookmark bridge. JSZip was present in app.asar.

observations.step: Start a search in Alpha and switch to Bravo while the 240-page scan is pending
observations.evidence: The renderer switched to Document Bravo.pdf and rendered a page canvas without allowing the previous document result to replace the current search state.

observations.step: Search for the Alpha-only phrase in Bravo
observations.evidence: The visible result state was No matches.

observations.step: Save a bookmark from the Reader toolbar
observations.evidence: The mocked persistence bridge received addBookmark for the current document.

observations.step: Keep Reader chrome visible after opening a PDF
observations.evidence: After the fix, reader toolbar top=0, sidebar header top=17, window.scrollY=0, reader viewport scrollTop=0. Screenshot: floa-reader-headless-2026-11-26.png.

limitations: Chrome headless validates the local Reader HTML and renderer, not the Electron BrowserWindow integration.
The readerApp bridge was stubbed; native file picker, on-disk persistence, and macOS keyboard routing were not exercised.
The PDF and EPUB headless harnesses use generated local fixtures rather than Glaso documents.
No visible app window was created and the existing Just Browse process was left untouched.
